selection.angle: IBM raises the floor of annual software growth guidance while leaving the ceiling unchanged. Separate delayed transaction-processing deals from management-described net new business before judging durable demand.
selection.evidence_plan: Use only sealed goal35-ibm Reuters facts, published 2026-10-21T20:12:00Z and known at 2026-10-21T22:27:23.029Z. Preserve the single Reuters origin and attribute Kavanaugh statements through Reuters. Annual SOFTWARE revenue growth outlook is about 7%-8% versus prior 6%-8%: lower bound raised, upper bound unchanged. Total Q3 revenue +4.7% to $17.10 billion versus $16.82 billion LSEG estimate, and software revenue +8.3% to $7.80 billion versus $7.62 billion estimate, are separate metrics. About 25% from deferred Q2 deals and remaining 75% net new business describe TRANSACTION PROCESSING revenue only, per Kavanaugh via Reuters; never all IBM/software revenue or growth contributions. Do not compute dollar contributions or organic growth. Code owns arithmetic. Reported extended-session share rise about 4% proves neither lasting demand nor the cause of the move. Missing: transaction-processing denominator/comparisons, normalized growth excluding deferred deals, margins/cash conversion, recurrence and independent company-release corroboration. No additional retrieval, requests, quotations or media.
selection.primary_reader_question: Does the higher IBM software outlook signal durable new demand, or partly the arrival of deals delayed from the previous quarter?
research_queries: IBM October 21 2026 software outlook transaction processing deferred Q2 net new business
selection.selection_rationale: Fresh software guidance and a reported narrow revenue composition support a useful current company question. Explain what improved and the limits of the deal-mix evidence. Distinct from handled oil and historical filing-reading explainers; other current company/FX reports remain separate operations. Single-source report truth is not independent event confirmation.

comparison: Oil excluded as handled. IBM has no supplied evolving prior story or proprietary Main report. Other current company/FX candidates are independent later operations, not fallbacks. Historical official/Main oil-gas context and retained custody, Fed/FX, hedging, SEC supervision, cross-trading, machine-data and filing explainers supply no fresh IBM confirmation. Seven published identities were deterministically filtered; full published corpus is absent, so no exhaustive independent history audit is claimed.
mechanism: Delayed transactions can lift a quarter without proving repeatability. Management-described net new transaction-processing business is a competing reason to take demand seriously; its narrow denominator cannot establish company-wide demand composition.
countercase: An all-catch-up interpretation ignores the management-described net new business and software result above estimates. A durable broad acceleration interpretation ignores deferred activity, the unchanged ceiling and missing recurrence/margin/cash evidence.
watch_conditions: Later comparable results separating delayed and new transaction-processing activity could test persistence.
Later guidance, recurring demand, margins and cash conversion could change the reading. These are conditional missing inputs, not authorized new requests.
writer_outline: Lead with the raised floor and unchanged ceiling.
Keep company, software and transaction-processing denominators separate.
Explain timing recovery versus management-described new business with attribution.
Give competing interpretations and concrete conditions for changing the reading.
rights: Facts only; original prose, no quotations or media reuse
